sessions.title: Agent sessions
sessions.subtitle: Parallel coding sessions on their own worktrees. Nothing is merged or pushed automatically.
sessions.no_prices: No prices yet. Sessions without a price pause before spending.
sessions.key_ref_hint: Name of a key saved in the keychain (e.g. byok.openai.work), never the key itself. Required for anthropic, openai, minimax and gateway.
sessions.no_sessions: No sessions yet. Mark a repository, set a price and create one.
sessions.confirm_stalled: I checked the worktree: resume this stalled session
sessions.task_paths: Paths it will touch (comma separated globs, optional)
sessions.accept_no_merge: Accepting does NOT merge anything: it only closes the task and frees the session. The branch stays for you to integrate.
sessions.confirm_close: Close session #{0}? The worktree is kept; an unfinished task goes back to the queue.
sessions.confirm_stalled_dialog: Session #{0} stalled (no heartbeat). Resume it only if you checked its worktree. Resume now?
sessions.confirm_accept: Accept task #{0}? This does NOT merge: the branch and its diff stay as they are.
sessions.confirm_reject: Reject task #{0}? It is marked failed and the session is freed.
sessions.need_stalled_confirm: Tick the confirmation to resume a stalled session.
sessions.err_network: Could not reach the local server.
sessions.err_forbidden_origin: Request refused: it did not come from this app.
sessions.code_off_platform: Code sessions are turned off on this system (Windows): there is no OS sandbox for running commands yet, and ConductLoop never runs them without one.
sessions.code_off_sandbox: Running commands is turned off: the OS sandbox (bubblewrap on Linux) is missing or does not work. Agents can still read and edit files, but cannot run tests.
sessions.err_price_missing: Set a price for this model first (Prices panel), then resume.
sessions.err_budget_exhausted: Budget exhausted: raise the budget to resume.
sessions.err_iteration_limit: Iteration limit reached: raise max iterations to resume.
sessions.err_confirm_required: This session stalled: confirm explicitly to resume it.
